newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kmart shares rise.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kmart shares rise.

text.p: Shares of Kmart Corp rose five percent after business during the month of July picked up at its stores due to clearance sales, analysts said Monday.
-- Kmart's shares rose 9/16 to 11-1/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.

-- Prudential Securities analyst Wayne Hood said he estimated Kmart's comparable-store sales, or sales at stores open a year, have risen by the high-single-digits in percentage terms during July. "But that's mostly clearance," he added, noting that much of the merchandise being sold has been marked down.

-- Last month Kmart's same-store sales rose 5.3 percent. In addition, the company has said net income for the second quarter will be below the profit recorded in the same period of last year of $34 million, or $0.07 a share.
